why_this_file_exists: BR-8. In round 2 the six construction files carrying the round's load-bearing counterexample were unbindable for the second consecutive batch. This index is the fix and is a declared artifact of this task, so the ledger archive can bind the objects by content. IT MAY LIST ZERO FILES AND IT MAY NEVER BE ABSENT.
mechanism_used_to_build_every_object: RUN-TIME CONSTRUCTION AND RUN-TIME PROJECTION WRAPPERS ONLY. NO COMMITTED FILE UNDER harness/ WAS MODIFIED, CREATED OR TOUCHED. harness/diffpath/depgraph.py and tests/test_diffpath_depgraph.py were never opened, read or imported; rt3_rederive.py asserts at run time that harness.diffpath.depgraph is absent from sys.modules.
quarantine_firewall_by_mechanism: harness.diffpath.census is NEVER IMPORTED and census.build_census is NEVER CALLED, so census.quarantine_attestation -- which opens the Tier-A payload 'rb' -- is never reached. The 16 shadow entries are rebuilt directly from the two declared planted-path seeds with the committed pathobj.seeded_pair and pathobj.plant_from_pair, which read nothing from disk.
how_to_re_run: DIFFP_REPO=<repo root> python3 <this directory>/constructions/rt3_rederive.py and .../rt3_objects.py. Both are deterministic at the eight frozen seeds and print JSON to stdout. Neither creates a run directory, mints a RUN-* identifier, writes a manifest or consumes a charged run.
